verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Medusa CLI documented at docs.medusajs.com/resources/medusa-cli, and the pricing page advertises a 'Medusa MCP and Cloud CLI', so an official CLI clearly exists. The evidence only shows that it exists, with no detail on its commands or how it fits AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: documentation of the CLI's commands and capabilities, evidence of agent- or AI-oriented CLI workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.
